title: Amer Sports named to the 100 Best Corporate Citizens List
summary: Amer Sports has been named one of the 100 Best Corporate Citizens of 2026, ranking #84 on the list developed by 3BL in partnership with ISS-Corporate.
body_markdown:
Amer Sports has been named one of the 100 Best Corporate Citizens of 2026, ranking #84 on the list developed by[3BL](https://www.3blmedia.com/) in partnership with[ISS-Corporate](https://www.iss-corporate.com/) . Among Russell 1000 companies, we’ve moved up 451 places across three consecutive rankings: from #535 in 2024, to #170 in 2025, to #84 in 2026.


The 100 Best Corporate Citizens ranks the largest publicly traded U.S. companies on transparency and performance across climate change, environmental management, human rights, employee wellbeing, governance, and community impact. All data used in the ranking is publicly available: extracted from corporate websites, SEC filings, policies, and third-party sources such as[GRI](https://www.globalreporting.org/) ,[SBTi](https://sciencebasedtargets.org/) , and the[UN Global Compact](https://unglobalcompact.org/) . Within the Consumer Durables & Apparel industry, we ranked #3, and our overall score of 66.69 came in well above the industry average of 48.14.


“This recognition is a reflection of our long-term, consistent efforts on sustainability, and we’re grateful that it helps make that work more visible. It is the result of steadily strengthening how we act on our environmental and social impact, year after year. We see this as a milestone, not a finish line,” says Tea Lindfors, Director, Sustainability Reporting


3BL’s research also found that companies on the 100 Best Corporate Citizens list have historically outperformed the S&P 500 financially, by 10% cumulatively, and 2.2% annually over a 42-month backtest, reinforcing the link between transparency and long-term business performance.
